reason.en: The stiffness-ratio extreme: an 18 m bench on a 3 m burden, six burdens tall. Its hole diameter is the one the source never printed, recovered by inverting the stated bench height and agreeing on all six rows.
reason.es: El extremo de rigidez del banco: 18 m de altura sobre 3 m de bordo, seis bordos de alto. Su diametro es el que la fuente nunca publico, recuperado invirtiendo la altura declarada y coincidente en las seis filas.
